name: whatsapp-ai
description: Asistente de IA para WhatsApp (Cloud API oficial de Meta + Claude de Anthropic) con panel de administración

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,panel -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
